title: Investment Strategy App & MCP
author: TankNegative7921
selftext:
Create a free account: [https://investboard.com](https://investboard.com)

This app will help you define your investment strategy and keep it.   
  
The basic account for one portfolio is free. You will find all portfolio intelligence at one place. And you can use it also via MCP with your AI agents. All data are stored safely in AWS Frankfurt and regulated in the EU.
